planComparison: Frozen engineering estimate 1,750 meaningful new lines; actual 886 production additions/8 removals across 14 source paths. Reused stable Google OAuth SDK, owner credential handlers, guarded registry, existing encryption key and session policy; substantially exceeded the 400-800 guide by completing three entire interconnected cards rather than padding.
newEngineering: Original P10-1/2/3 full dual identity foundation: V2 scoped SQL+AAD grant store, OAuth2 verified OIDC and browser-bound login/link, hardened owner-compatible OAuth choice and separate principal credential rotation, exact scoped account portal and 5 real Postgres+new unit tests.
relatedWorkDecision: Keep outcome B P10-1..3 one PR #202; P10-4 full tool/DB/provider isolation and P10-5 customer admin delegation remain separately approved subsequent outcome. Leave PUBLIC_SIGNIN_MODE off and public tool dispatch denied; Hub, Google production config and paid provider tests untouched.

criteria.evidence: `src/principals/store.js:initPrincipalSchema` creates additive principals, issuer/sub, composite account ownership, private defaults, hashed OAuth/session credentials, delegations and deletion requests; `src/principals/crypto.js` seals V2 grants with principal/account/purpose AAD; `scopedStore` admits only server-minted frozen contexts.

criteria.criterion: Explicitly map old database/token/Hub grants to a fixed legacy owner adapter without public fallback; old upgrades twice and owner bearer/read/refresh/deny must still work.
criteria.evidence: `src/db.js:initSchema` runs additive V2 schema; explicit owner UUID, original oauth_tokens and google_accounts data remain; direct native owner MCP `legacyOwnerContext` requires exact stored original bearer; `test/db/principal-store.test.js` ran five real-Postgres tests and old upgrade/Hub TEST regression suites passed in correction run #39002582767.

criteria.criterion: Verify foreign reference denial, concurrent account refresh compare-and-swap, exact scoped store membership, developer caller inventory and public dispatch disabled before P10-4.
criteria.evidence: `test/db/principal-store.test.js` covers two principals' foreign account/default denial, concurrent token-version CAS and browser/code/refresh races; `test/unit/p10-mcp-gate.test.js` proves new bearer is blocked from every legacy Google client before P10-4; `docs/plan/evidence/p10-storage-caller-matrix.json` lists explicitly unscoped callers and their future isolation requirements.

criteria.criterion: Offer public start/callback/session/logout, pilot verified subject admission and browser-bound one-use callback; existing owner OAuth project and login never change.
criteria.evidence: `api/auth/google/callback.js` atomically consumes server-stored transaction with browser binding; `verifyGoogleCode` invokes Google SDK verifyIdToken with intended audience and validates verified issuer, expiry, nonce, email_verified, subject; legacy owner email cannot be auto-claimed; `test/unit/p10-google-auth.test.js` tests claims and no fallback.

criteria.criterion: Add authenticated incremental Google grant linking, independently verify identity and ownership, encrypt grants and preserve missing refresh token; test tampering, replay and consent rejection.
criteria.evidence: `api/account.js` POST link, distinct Google start/callback POST link purpose, exact session CSRF and verified issuer/sub ownership, per-provider scope checks and encrypted grant storage; updates preserve old refresh tokens. `test/unit/p10-auth-routes.test.js` covers foreign cookies, replay, pilot rejection and link consent; `test/db/principal-store.test.js` covers grant CAS/cross-owner denial.

criteria.criterion: Offer neutral MCP authorization choice while continuing existing owner sign-in; V2 OAuth code and token exchanges bind registered client/redirect, S256 PKCE, resource, immutable principal/account/policy.
criteria.evidence: `api/oauth/authorize.js` has neutral owner/Google choice, no owner account DB lookup before successful passphrase, and V2 principal-only account choice; `api/oauth/token.js` splits p10c_ authorization and p10r_ refresh from existing owner path with exact registered client/redirect/S256 PKCE/resource, denying provider tokens to agents.

criteria.criterion: Use dedicated hashed V2 access/refresh store with atomic single-use refresh family replay denial, user session and account management; never dispatch V2 tools until P10-4 isolation.
criteria.evidence: `src/principals/store.js` issues hashed p10a_/p10r_ credentials with atomic one-use refresh/family replay revocation, exact stored principal/account/profile/areas/client/resource, and `api/mcp.js` rejects public execution 403 before loading owner provider clients until P10-4. `test/db/principal-store.test.js` proves race/replay; `test/unit/p10-mcp-authorize.test.js`, `p10-mcp-gate.test.js` and original direct MCP fixtures cover route semantics.

criteria.criterion: Prove two-user HTTP/real-Postgres code replay/foreign account/revoke/CSRF separation and owner OAuth/native/RTC regression.
criteria.evidence: `api/account.js` and `/api/auth/session`, `/api/auth/logout` show only own agent/grant entries, enforce CSRF and exact IDs on local revocation, disconnect, default, and recoverable deletion; browser logout leaves agent credentials alone. `test/unit/p10-auth-routes.test.js` and real-Postgres tests cover two-identity session/revoke isolation and owner continuity.
